projects.title: SafePath AI
projects.description: An AI-powered disaster early-warning and evacuation route guidance platform engineered across 3 phases of the AI for All Hackathon. Transforms multi-source hazard data into real-time risk scores (hazard, exposure, vulnerability), predicts risk escalation, provides safe evacuation paths, and features a multilingual crisis-calm chatbot.
projects.role: AI/ML Developer, Team ResiliAfrica · AI for All Hackathon (Phase 1 Ideation → Phase 2 Prototyping → Phase 3 Regional Finals, Alexandria)

projects.title: Renewable Energy Grid Maintenance Network
projects.description: A full-stack app for managing renewable energy sites, power units, technicians, and maintenance inspections. Raw SQL on a SQL Server schema, 6+ analytical queries, a dashboard summary view, and a light/dark vanilla JS frontend.
projects.role: Team Lead · led 5 members, owned timeline, architecture, and technical decisions · May 2026

projects.title: Quizer
projects.description: A full-stack exam platform with quiz creation, quiz-taking, exam history, profile pages, and sign-in / registration flows, deployed on Vercel.

projects.title: Soccer League
projects.description: A Java desktop app for managing teams, players, and matches, backed by a SQL Server database with its own schema and seed script.

projects.title: PHP Travel Booking System
projects.description: Designed and ran test cases for the booking, search, and payment workflows of a travel booking web app, logged functional defects, and verified fixes with the dev team using manual and automated testing.
projects.role: Team Lead · led 5 members, owned timeline and architecture · DEPI, Nov–Dec 2025

aboutLines.text: I’m Mohamed Tamer, in my third year of Software Engineering at Cairo University’s Faculty of Computing and Artificial Intelligence.
I design and build AI-powered products: RAG systems, ML models, Computer Vision applications, and production-ready backends with FastAPI.
Backed by rigorous mathematical and statistical training in probability distributions, hypothesis testing, and exploratory data analysis to ensure models are accurate and reliable.
I help startups, businesses, and recruiters turn ideas into reliable, working software.
I combine solid software engineering with hands-on machine learning, so my solutions are not just smart but deployable.
Completed 250+ hours in the Microsoft ML Engineer track at DEPI (with AMIT Learning), mastering end-to-end ML, Deep Learning, and Azure MLOps, alongside freelancing on Upwork, Mostaql, and Kafeel.
I’ve led two 5-member teams directing architecture and delivery, and reached the regional finals in Alexandria after completing all three phases of the AI for All Hackathon.
I’m driven by building technology that protects and helps people, like early-warning systems for disasters.
